recommendations.title: Reject r or s outside [1, n-1] before any verification arithmetic
recommendations.observedIssue: verify() in acme-sign 1.4.2 accepts (r = 0, s = 0) for any message (run #3), and 63 of 2000 sampled out-of-range pairs, all with r = 0 (run #10).
recommendations.proposedChange: Add an explicit check that 1 <= r <= n-1 and 1 <= s <= n-1 at the top of verify(), returning a rejection before any modular inverse or point multiplication. Add regression tests for (0, 0), (0, s), (r, 0), (n, s), (r, n).
guidanceReference: Standard ECDSA verification specifies the range check on r and s as its first step (general guidance; no specific document is cited in sample data).
Project Wycheproof ECDSA tests include zero-component vectors for this reason.
recommendations.expectedBenefit: Closes the demonstrated forgery path for all-zero and zero-r signatures in the tested entry point.
tradeOffs: Two extra comparisons per verification (negligible; run #13 shows no measurable latency change).
applicabilityLimits: Covers verify() only. The signing path and other entry points were not tested.
Says nothing about other defect classes.
verificationSteps: Re-run the malformed-signature test (expect 8 of 8 rejected).
Re-run protocol v1 with the same seed (expect 0 of 2000 accepted).
Re-run latency (expect no p99 regression against run #6).

recommendations.title: Remove sha1 from the signing service's allowed digests
recommendations.observedIssue: allowed_digests in the 2026-10 configuration includes sha1. Acme reports no production caller selects it.
recommendations.proposedChange: Remove sha1 from allowed_digests and add a start-up check that rejects configurations listing it.
guidanceReference: Current digest guidance deprecates SHA-1 for digital signatures (general guidance).
recommendations.expectedBenefit: Removes a permitted-but-unused weak option; reduces configuration drift risk.
tradeOffs: Any undocumented caller selecting sha1 would start failing; Acme should confirm iq-3 and search call sites first.
applicabilityLimits: General guidance: this project did not test any sha1-digested signature and measured no effect.
verificationSteps: Import the revised configuration and re-run the configuration scan (expect no sha1).
